stories.title: Roma, aggredito in monopattino: grave l'attore Davide Iacopini

en.title: Rome, actor attacked on scooter: Davide Iacopini in serious condition
en.summary: Actor Davide Iacopini, 42, was kicked by a mini car and suffered a severe head trauma, now hospitalized in intensive care. Authorities are investigating for attempted murder and whether the vehicle was involved in a previous assault.

stories.title: Sale a 24 morti il bilancio dei raid russi in Ucraina

en.title: Death toll from Russian raids in Ukraine rises to 24
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky reported that a single building in Pryluky sustained 18 deaths including four children from Russian military strikes.

stories.title: Per Fiore e Castellino di Forza Nuova confermate le condanne per l'assalto alla Cgil del 2021

en.title: Convictions upheld for Fiore and Castellino of Forza Nuova over 2021 CGIL assault
en.summary: Sentences were confirmed for two far-right activists involved in damaging a trade union headquarters during protests against pandemic workplace restrictions.

stories.title: Garlasco, Dna maschile sulla bici di Stasi “dimenticato” in un armadio dei Ris

en.title: Garlasco, male DNA on Stasi's bike "forgotten" in RIS storage
en.summary: Investigators discovered unexamined male DNA evidence on a bicycle stored for years, adding to questions about the case following recent findings of missing blood evidence from the victim.

stories.title: Nuovo contratto per dirigenti medici: fino a 560 euro in più. Meloni: "Passo concreto"

en.title: New contract for medical directors: up to 560 euros more. Meloni: "Concrete step"
en.summary: A new employment contract for approximately 138,000 medical and healthcare professionals includes wage increases and new protections against violence, with support from all union representatives.

stories.title: Addio a Barbara Spinelli. La giornalista ed ex europarlamentare si è spenta ad 80 anni

en.title: Farewell to Barbara Spinelli. The journalist and former MEP passed away at 80
en.summary: Barbara Spinelli, a founding member of La Repubblica newspaper and former European Parliament member, has died at age 80.

stories.title: Grave l’attore Davide Iacopini, aggredito mentre era in monopattino. Caccia alla banda della minicar

en.title: Actor Davide Iacopini seriously injured, attacked while on scooter. Hunt for minicar gang
en.summary: Actor Davide Iacopini was kicked off his scooter on October 5 and remains hospitalized in intensive care. Authorities are investigating similar incidents in Rome's Monteverde neighborhood.

stories.title: È morta Barbara Spinelli, giornalista ed europarlamentare. Fu tra i fondatori di Repubblica

en.title: Barbara Spinelli dies, journalist and MEP. She was among Repubblica's founders
en.summary: Barbara Spinelli, daughter of European Union founding father Altiero Spinelli and an influential journalist and politician, has passed away at 80.

stories.title: Roma, l’attore di “Suburra” Davide Iacopini aggredito sul monopattino: è in terapia intensiva

en.title: Rome, 'Suburra' actor Davide Iacopini attacked on scooter: in intensive care
en.summary: Actor Davide Iacopini was kicked in the Monteverde area of Rome and hospitalized with severe head trauma. Prosecutors are investigating the incident as attempted murder.

stories.title: È morta Barbara Spinelli, giornalista ed ex europarlamentare: aveva 80 anni

en.title: Barbara Spinelli dies, journalist and former MEP: she was 80 years old
en.summary: Journalist and former European Parliament member Barbara Spinelli has died at age 80. She spent decades reporting on and analyzing major shifts in European and international politics.

stories.title: Gimbe, la sanità pubblica perde 18,8 miliardi: crescono costi, assicurazioni e rinunce alle cure

en.title: Gimbe, public healthcare loses 18.8 billion: costs, insurance, and care denials grow
en.summary: Italy's healthcare system faces pressure as assistance costs rise, regions struggle with spending, millions forgo medical visits, and healthcare staffing remains insufficient.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia. Zelensky: “Solo oggi 18 morti, tra cui 4 bambini, in raid russo su un condominio: è il regalo di compleanno per Putin”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia War. Zelensky: "Only today 18 dead, including 4 children, in Russian raid on apartment building: Putin's birthday gift"
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky reported 18 deaths including four children from a Russian strike on a residential building. NATO's Military Committee visited Kyiv while Russia struck ships off Bulgaria with no survivors reported.

stories.title: Asfalto, il caro energia moltiplica i costi

en.title: Asphalt, expensive energy multiplies costs
en.summary: Asphalt production value reached 4 billion euros with output of 34.8 million tonnes, up 3.6 percent compared to 2025. Rising energy costs have significantly increased production expenses.

stories.title: Salone del Mobile 2027, al centro il mercato dei grandi progetti

en.title: Salone del Mobile 2027, focus on the large projects market
en.summary: The 65th edition of Salone del Mobile will introduce a new Contract division aimed at supporting companies in a market valued at 80-100 billion euros.

stories.title: Smart working, la pausa pranzo viene penalizzata

en.title: Smart working, lunch break is penalized
en.summary: Remote work arrangements present unexpected drawbacks for lunch breaks, including isolation, skipped meals, and reduced social interaction opportunities among employees.

stories.title: Morato Group cresce in Germania, nasce un polo di eccellenza del bakery

en.title: Morato Group expands in Germany, establishing a bakery excellence hub
en.summary: Morato Group, founded in 1970 and based in Altavilla Vicentina near Vicenza, acquires German bakery company Jaus Bakery to establish a European center of excellence in the baking sector.

stories.title: In Valle d’Aosta il gruppo Hti apre un hub tecnologico

en.title: In Valle d'Aosta the Hti group opens a technology hub
en.summary: The Hti Group, which owns Leitner cable car systems, Prinoth snow groomers, and Demaclenko snowmaking equipment, is strengthening its presence in the northwestern region by opening a technology hub in Valle d'Aosta.
